title: Port FACe invoice submission to the TypeScript client
blocker: The requests are prepared locally and the public certificates are available. An accepted test response with a verified SOAP signature and a supplier portal receipt matched to its registration code remain unverified.
unblock: Retrieve both artifacts from an existing test exchange or authorize one scoped synthetic submission using a certificate already associated with a supplier platform in the test integrator portal. Verify the SOAP response signature on the original bytes. Verify the portal receipt by CSV and match its REGAGE number and invoice to the SOAP registration.
notes: `facturae.py`, XAdES SHA-512 byte-compatible with AutoFirma through
`afirma_bridge.py`). Port it here with the local XAdES signer rather than
the AutoFirma bridge. Needs the Facturae profile and digest items under
Signing, plus a WS-Security envelope signer.
Verified the offline invoice and legacy SOAP with xmlsec1 and synthetic data. No invoice was transmitted.

The public supplier WSDL at https://ws.face.gob.es/proveedores/v1/factura?wsdl responded HTTP 200. It contains an inline RPC-literal SOAP 1.1 contract with FacturaFile.factura and FacturaFile.nombre, without the legacy mime field.

Located section 4.2 of the FACe supplier SOAP manual and verified the request shape against the public supplier WSDL. The documented binary certificate token and digest enable offline request preparation.

The source API prepares the supplier v1 RPC-literal request for a single invoice without annexes. It uses the documented WS-Security binary X.509 token, RSA-SHA1 signature method, and SHA-256 body digest. The live public WSDL and its inline XSD passed an independent local check against the built output.

2026-11-27: The official FACe downloads catalogue labels SELLO_DE_ENTIDAD_AEAD_2025 as the current production SOAP-response signing certificate: https://administracionelectronica.gob.es/ctt/face/descargas. Its official DER download https://administracionelectronica.gob.es/ctt/resources/Soluciones/334/Descargas/SELLO_DE_ENTIDAD_AEAD_2025.cer has SHA-256 b08a990ba71c3182f8b3e9f2430b0b59d3550f06e027c1284cd509880db6e735, verified with a direct file hash, standalone OpenSSL fingerprint and Node X509Certificate. This digital-signature leaf is valid from 2025-09-09 through 2028-09-09 UTC. The SOAP test signing certificate was not verified. A real response still needs signature binding and receipt validation.

2026-11-27: FACe support announced the two separate AEAD documents after postponing the change (https://listas-ctt.administracionelectronica.gob.es/pipermail/face-soporte/2026-September/000219.html) and scheduled the replacement for 2026-09-14 (https://listas-ctt.administracionelectronica.gob.es/pipermail/face-soporte/2026-September/000220.html). The earlier official notice identifies the replacement catalogue entry as idElemento=11529. These notices are schedule evidence, not proof of the signer on a live response. The historical test certificate attached to the 2021 FACe notice was checked as X.509 and expired on 2024-08-12. A current test signer is still required.

The official test WSDL returned HTTP 200. Supplier v1 now signs the test namespace and returns the matching SOAPAction when the caller chooses sandbox. Production remains the default, and local xmlsec1 tests verified the signed bodies in both environments. Source: https://se-ws-face.redsara.es/proveedores/v1/factura?wsdl

The official catalogue test attachment SELLO-ENTIDAD-SGAD-PRUEBAS-crt.crt contains plain base64 DER. The actual certificate is valid from 2024-05-14 through 2027-05-14 UTC, despite the old expiry in the catalogue description. The DER SHA-256 is ea40480883fcf914d7e67e9ec3c60275ab9ee0e437472248e5ec37afa9444334. The separate Nuevo SELLO-DE-ENTIDAD-AEAD-crt.crt production attachment is valid from 2026-09-04 through 2028-12-31 UTC, DER SHA-256 94f852d267a22a6eedac61cd315f77eaf2da9486d8f8a86c4cea3d94c13594da. Both hashes were independently checked with the DER file hash, OpenSSL and Node. Source: https://administracionelectronica.gob.es/ctt/face/descargas

The supplier v1 WSDL defines EnviarFacturaResponse.factura.registro with codigo and fecha. Its file list describes Facturae, the European invoice and annexes. The official SOAP manual example omits the response signature and shows the registration rather than a receipt PDF. Supplier portal manual sections 3.2 and 3.4 describe the separate PDF and its CSV verification. Integrator manual sections 3 and 4 require associating a request signing certificate with a platform. Preserve the complete original signed SOAP privately for verification because sanitizing the signed body changes its digest. Sources: https://administracionelectronica.gob.es/ctt/face/descargas
